summary: This implementation does not merely retain a generic long-row path: its constructor builds a longRows index list for rows longer than 32*threadsPerRow when using short-row groups, and dispatches those listed rows through the shared block-row arithmetic; the remaining rows are grid-strided by blocks. For uniformly long matrices, width 64/128/256 selects a separate block-per-row kernel that grid-strides rows. Both routes visit each full CSR interval and store each row. run performs one warmup, captures batch=min(iterations,64) when batch>1, and times quotient graph launches plus exact remainder launches (or the single direct iteration); stop event sync and output copy follow. Source selector/list construction, launch dispatch, compiled run/constructor and all nine selectable native sm86 kernels were inspected.
